wrong_email.ui_message: That license and email do not match an active Verlune Premium purchase.

invalid_license.ui_message: Premium access could not be verified right now. Please try again.
invalid_license.defect: Invalid/rejected license validation was mapped to provider-unavailable UX instead of controlled invalid-entitlement denial.

changes: Added typed LemonLicenseApiError carrying operation, HTTP status and provider reason.
Validation 4xx responses except rate-limit are now mapped to the same controlled 401 entitlement-denial message as wrong-email/mismatch cases.
Provider/network/5xx errors remain 502 so outages are not mislabeled as invalid purchases.

sensitive_data_boundary: The operator screenshot exposed a Test-mode license key to the conversation.
The key value is intentionally not recorded in repository evidence.
Because it is Test-mode only, it does not represent a live customer entitlement; it should still be treated as exposed test credential and disabled/deleted after this qualification cycle.
